lockup.summary: The company, its directors, its officers and all current holders agreed not to sell shares for six months after the offering closes. The 3,750,000 shares sold in the offering can be traded right away.

what: Little West is a California company that makes and sells cold-pressed juices and health and wellness products.
proceeds: It plans to split the net money equally: 20% each for expanding distribution, marketing, working capital, hiring staff and general company needs. It says it has broad freedom in how it uses the money.
risks: It is a holding company and depends on payments from its subsidiaries to cover its costs and pay any dividends.
It may not get enough produce and other raw materials, because it relies on few growers and one broker and distributor.
It has no formal contracts with its suppliers of produce and bottles, so its business could suffer if partners fail it.
